answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a hardware-attested orbit slot, so a node's ephemeral key is chained to a signed telemetry beacon whose yarrow-seeded nonce proves liveness at perigee. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
